literal: One day like seven days will pass, to those who yearn keeping in mind the coming day of him who went far away.
translation: For those who yearn, counting the days until the return of their lover who has gone far away, a single day drags on like seven.
modern: நெடுந்தொலைவு சென்ற காதலர் திரும்பி வரும் நாளைக் கணக்கிட்டு ஏங்கித் தவிப்பவர்களுக்கு, ஒரு நாள் ஏழு நாட்களைப் போல மிக நீளமாகச் செல்லும்.
explanation: This couplet captures the psychological experience of time for a waiting lover. The phrase 'ஒரு நாள் எழு நாள் போல் செல்லும்' (one day passes like seven days) vividly illustrates how time seems to stretch and slow down during periods of intense longing. The lover is described as 'சேண் சென்றார்' (he who went far away), emphasizing the physical distance that fuels the emotional pain. By 'வரு நாள் வைத்து' (keeping the day of return in mind), the poem shows how constantly calculating the time of reunion only deepens the yearning.
